QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_20

question.text: Under Regulation 22 of the SEBI (AIF) Regulations, which of the following does the Manager of Kaveri Capital AIF NOT need to disclose to investors?

answer.text: Financial, risk management, operational, portfolio and transactional information on fund investments.
Any inquiries/legal actions by legal or regulatory bodies in any jurisdiction, as and when they occur.
The specific source of every commitment from each LP and the LP's personal tax records.
Any material liability arising during the AIF's tenure, as and when it occurs.

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 22 requires investor disclosure of items such as financial, risk-management, operational, portfolio and transactional information on the fund's investments; fees to the Manager, Sponsor and associates; inquiries or legal actions by regulatory or legal bodies; material liabilities; breaches of the PPM or fund documents; changes of control of the Sponsor, Manager or investee; significant changes in the key investment team; and systemic-risk information. The specific source of every individual LP commitment and an LP's personal tax records are not among these required investor disclosures. The Trap: The other three options closely paraphrase actual Regulation 22 items: portfolio and transactional information, inquiries and legal actions, and material liabilities. Only the option about LP personal tax records and source of every commitment falls outside the Regulation 22 list. Note: The right way to attack this question is to scan each option against the Regulation 22 disclosure list and identify the one that is not on it; LP-level personal tax records and per-commitment source-of-funds are not part of the required investor disclosures under Regulation 22.
